items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I never played with him. I played close around him.

ctx.x: The parlor park. Near the St. Louis Cathedral?

Yeah, St. Louis, right. I believe it was the first and second door. Yeah. When God drew Frank, he gave me 50 cents. I said, what's this? He said, that's what the job paid $2 for. I said, Frank, don't ever, never, never come here with no 50 cents. I said, what's this? I said, what's this? I said, what's this? I said, what's this? And then we used to play on Decatur Street, Dollar Ballard. We called it the Popeye. You know how the college used to play that? That's how they called it, Popeye. Canuletti. Oh, Little…
Yeah, they had a nightclub day.
